observations: The census symbol names 0x61c1210 as the std::call_once lambda inside Comparator::CreateFromString, not as RegisterBuiltinComparators itself: the static function is inlined into the lambda, and the lambda's body is exactly the three AddFactory calls from upstream util/comparator.cc:598-634.

Block 1's name is built with OVERLAPPING movdqa stores: the first 16-byte store writes 'leveldb.Bytewise' at +0 and the second 16-byte store writes 'tewiseComparator' at +10, overwriting the first fragment's trailing 'tewise' with identical bytes. The result is 'leveldb.BytewiseComparator' (26); the overlap is a compiler artifact of the two fragments sharing the 'tewise' run, not two different spellings.
Block 2's name is built the same way without overlap: 16 bytes at +0, 16 bytes at +16, then a single movb $0x72 ('r') at +32 -- 33 chars total.

The three std::function objects are 32 bytes: 16 zeroed functor bytes, the manager at +0x10, the factory stub at +0x18. The functor storage stays zero because the callable is the stub itself, held at +0x18; the manager is what AddFactory loads from +0x10.

The managers' op-0 slots (0x64d6ff8 / 0x64d7008 / 0x64d7018) each carry an R_X86_64_64 relocation to _ZTVN10__cxxabiv117__class_type_infoE + 0x10; the file bytes are zero and the runtime value materializes at load. The three managers are otherwise byte-identical in shape (45 B each, differing only in the op-0 LEA displacement and the relative branch targets).

The two manager call sites pass op 2 (inside AddFactory, before the pair is copied out by movdqu) and op 3 (the local destroy after each AddFactory); both are no-ops in the manager's dispatch, and the pair itself is transferred by the movdqu copy. The libstdc++ _Manager_operation naming for ops 2/3 is an open unknown (see below).

The function returns void: no 'mov $0x3,%eax' appears anywhere in the 2058-byte body, and eax is 0 on the normal return path (the last manager call returns 0, then the stack-canary check leaves eax 0). The upstream 'return 3' is discarded when RegisterBuiltinComparators is inlined into the call_once lambda.

The U64Ts name cache (guard 0x6508898, string 0x65088a0) is the ONLY guard in this function: the Bytewise/Reverse names are compile-time literals copied from .rodata, so only the third block can take a cold path. The cold path's ostringstream lives at rsp+0x120 and is destroyed (ios_base dtor + locale dtor) before the function returns.

The caller census finds exactly one reference to 0x61c1210: a LEA at 0x61c01fa in CreateFromString. The lambda is never called directly -- std::call_once takes its address and invokes it through the once_flag machinery.
open_unknowns: The runtime values of the three manager op-0 slots (0x64d6ff8 / 0x64d7008 / 0x64d7018): each carries an R_X86_64_64 relocation to _ZTVN10__cxxabiv117__class_type_infoE + 0x10, so the value materializes only at load; which libstdc++ functor-type record each slot points to is not pinned here.

The libstdc++ _Manager_operation enum naming for the op values observed here: AddFactory invokes the manager with op 2 and the local destroy with op 3, while the manager's dispatch only distinguishes op 0 (slot address) and op 1 (copy) from everything else (no-op returning 0). Whether op 2 is a move and op 3 the destroy in this libstdc++ version is not established from the binary alone.

ObjectLibrary::AddFactory 0x61c0d50 (792 B, census-bound) is an engine callee: its 0x70-byte registry entry and 0x30-byte node layouts are described at contract level only (name copy, (manager, stub) pair copy, 'Comparator' map insert under the mutex, duplicate-name find branch at 0x61c0fa0). Its full internal layout is not modeled in this packet.

Comparator::CreateFromString 0x61c0180..0x61c0cb4 (3244 B) has no vendor census record, so its body/source hashes cannot be bound the census way; its reconstruction (call_once registration, GetOptionsMap, the three name branches, the empty-value / unknown-id paths) is the follow-up, not this packet.
